review_scope: Source inspection of all fourteen originally flagged iteration-three contracts; five targeted synthetic cases. No claim that unflagged contracts or proposed repairs are qualified.

patterns.evidence: A bundle can omit a required record and also contradict another material fact; no explicit precedence.
Mixed evidence explicitly selects mixed_or_insufficient; frozen co-occurrence matches.
A trace can show one effect while the description states an absent idempotency boundary; observation and risk labels overlap.
Independent Nouls can co-occur; consumer must exclude instruction-like evidence. Frozen mixed fact/instruction matches all four intervals.
Noul has no competing Choice labels; absent top-level fields are guarded. Frozen unfinished adjacent sentence matches.
Conflicting or unclear material explicitly selects ambiguous rather than direct_answer; fresh conflicting direct-answer case matches. This does not certify every coverage boundary.
no_skill means no fit, not missing/conflicting task or shortlist. Multiple needed capabilities also lack explicit tie-break.
A focused semantic judgment may also compare supplied candidates; no explicit precedence between focused and comparison labels.
An explicitly exhaustive or expandable manifest can also contain unresolved duplicates; no explicit precedence.
Operational-burden Score levels all presuppose a stated burden; no availability companion, so unstated burden has no meaningful level.
Answer-bearing evidence can coexist with material conflict or an incomplete shortlist; no explicit route precedence.
Related/conflicting fields may coexist with deterministic evidence establishing distinct entities; no explicit precedence.
No missing/unclear label; dependent, oversized, and stale conditions can co-occur without explicit precedence.
Independent lane Nouls explicitly inspect recorded marks; co-occurring evidence, counterevidence and exclusion signals all match.
